notes.title: Fixed issues related to displaying dynamic text.
notes.content: [p]Previously, playing with some languages could result in a crash at the end-of-level scene on some hardware. This has been fixed.[/p][p]Additionally, user interface text was overlapping for some languages, and this has also been fixed.[/p]

notes.title: I'm on Observation Duty 8 is coming!
notes.content: [p]You can wishlist it now: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2564960"][/dynamiclink](sorry but no release date yet)[/p]

notes.title: Localizations and a new game mode
notes.content: [p]Localizations for 22 languages have been added.[/p][p]There's also a new game mode for players who have beaten the game: Randomizer. It brings together 5-8 random cameraviews from different levels. To unlock the mode, and a new option to make the game view black and white, the players must first beat all the levels.[/p]

notes.title: Small difficulty adjustments
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Few difficult anomalies that were previously present in both difficulty modes have been made hard-mode-only.
[*]Some clutter has been removed from the Apartment Building and Gas Station levels.
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
These are minor changes that make some of the earlier levels a bit more unforgiving on normal difficulty without affecting the overall difficulty too much.
